items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: The guy out there by the name of Jimmy Stahl was a newspaper columnist, you see. And he wrote it.

ctx.x: I just wondered if some of those fellas maybe weren't left-handed and just thought that was the way to do it because they saw somebody else.

Oh, that's the end of it. A funny little story, Bill, I went, in 34, I went to Hollywood with Gene Austin, you see. Well, I'd rather eat scent for me. The guy out there by the name of Jimmy Stahl was a newspaper columnist, you see. And he wrote it. We were playing at a little private, before we went in the coconut group, played at a private. They had a lot of private clubs out there that were gambling. Places like the Clover Club. Well, we played in a place called the El Rey. And it was strictly a membership…
How did you play the drums when you played the cornet? Just with your foot?
